text:
Ally (People Ops): quick q — payroll outage last night left a bunch of us with "queued" status when adding dependents in the benefits portal. I tried to add my partner and the portal shows pending but payroll hasn't picked up the deduction. Are we extending the open-enroll deadline for folks hit by the outage? cc @Miguel (Payroll) @Jess (Benefits)

Miguel (Payroll): we saw the outage, thx for flagging. outage broke the nightly sync between benefits provider and our payroll jobs. we're running the resync now and will manually apply any missed enrollments processed by benefits. payroll can't unilaterally extend business deadlines though — that's People Ops + Benefits call.

Jess (Benefits): +1. operationally we can accept retro enrollments if People Ops approves extension. we'll need the supporting docs (marriage certificate / domestic partnership affidavit / dependent birth certificate + SSN) uploaded to the secure docs portal so we can validate before payroll applies changes.

Ally (People Ops): ok scope: affected = anyone who tried to submit between 2028-11-03 22:00 UTC and 2028-11-04 06:00 UTC (window of outage). People Ops will extend the internal open-enroll cutoff for affected users to Friday 11:59pm PT. requirements to qualify: 1) portal shows "queued" OR error on submit, AND 2) supporting docs uploaded by the new cutoff. we'll send an all-company note and ping managers.

Tom (Eng): i'm on PTO until Thursday — saw the queued message yesterday. if i submit docs by Friday will my partner's coverage be effective retro to Nov 1? also what about HSA / pre-tax transit elections?

Miguel (Payroll): medical/vision/dental: if we get validated docs and benefits confirms the change, payroll will apply retro adjustments for deductions back to the applicable plan effective date (typically the 1st of the month after the qualifying event). HSA and commuter are handled in payroll elections separately; if you changed HSA election in the benefits UI but payroll didn't get it, we can backfill HSA elections to the next payroll period but not earlier months for tax reasons.

Jess (Benefits): short examples to clarify:
- If you submitted an add-dependent for 11/01 and it's validated by us before the Friday cutoff, medical coverage will be effective 11/01 and payroll deductions will be applied retroactively if needed.
- HSA election changes: must be re-submitted in benefits UI and approved; effective date usually next payroll pay period.

Ally (People Ops): steps everyone affected should follow (please follow exactly so payroll can reconcile quickly):
1) Login to benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.com (use SSO)
2) Go to Enrollments -> Add Dependent -> complete form
3) Upload required docs under My Docs -> Secure Upload (allowed types: .pdf, .jpg; max 10MB)
4) In the portal message box include the original error screenshot and the timestamp you first tried to submit
5) If you can't access the portal, send a secure drop email to benefits@redwood-secure.com (subject: "OUTAGE_ENROLLMENT: <your-name>")

Pasteable snippet for the docs upload notes:
```
Name: Tom Engineer
Event: Add spouse
Original submit TS: 2028-11-03 23:12 UTC
Portal status: queued / error code 502
Docs attached: marriage_certificate.pdf
```

Miguel (Payroll): for payroll reconciliation we'll need the portal record + docs. payroll will run a reconciliation job on Monday and apply retro deductions in that payroll cycle; we'll post a reconciliation summary in #payroll after it's done.

Ally (People Ops): I'll send the company message now and update the benefits FAQ. Draft of announcement (happy to tweak):
"Heads up — due to a system outage overnight, employees who experienced errors when submitting benefit changes may have until Friday 11:59pm PT to re-upload documents and re-submit enrollments. See https://benefits.redwood.com or contact benefits@redwood-secure.com for help. People Ops will coordinate with Payroll to apply retro deductions where applicable."

Tom (Eng): thanks, that helps. one more thing — does this affect COBRA windows or dependent removal timing?

Jess (Benefits): removal events follow normal QLE rules; COBRA timelines are statutory and not changed by this internal extension. if someone's dependent removal was incorrectly processed due to the outage we will treat that as an administrative error and work with them individually.

HR Bot: reminder scheduled: "Upload docs for outage-affected enrollments" — recurring DM to any user who had a queued submission.

Ally (People Ops): thanks all. i'll post the announcement in ~5 and tag managers. if anyone sees edge cases (international benefits, visa-dependent forms), DM me and i'll loop Legal. :thumbsup:

Tom (Eng): :wave: thanks.

Ally (People Ops): closing note — timeline recap: new cutoff = Friday 11:59pm PT; payroll reconciliation Monday; retro deductions applied next payroll cycle. reach out to benefits@redwood-secure.com for help. :tada:
